description: Run a command in an existing sandbox and return stdout, stderr, and exit code inline. Streams over max_output_bytes (default 64KB) come back as a head+tail preview with the full output retained at stdoutPath/stderrPath in the sandbox.

env.description: Environment variables as a key→value object.

max_output_bytes.description: Per-stream inline output cap in bytes (default 65536). Larger output is truncated head+tail and kept in the sandbox at stdoutPath/stderrPath.

session_id.description: Sandbox session id (UUID), from tenki_create_sandbox or tenki_list_sandboxes.

name: tenki_exec

args.description: Arguments the executable was invoked with.

captureError.description: Present when the command ran but its output could not be read back; stdout/stderr are unknown, not empty.

exitCode.description: Process exit code; 0 means success. (The API omits zero values; the server normalizes an absent code to 0.)

ok.description: True only when exitCode is 0 AND stdout/stderr capture succeeded.

stderr.description: Captured standard error (empty when capture failed — see captureError).

stderrPath.description: Sandbox path holding the FULL stderr, present only when truncated — page through it with tenki_exec (e.g. sed -n / tail -c).

stderrTruncated.description: Present (true) when stderr exceeded the output cap and carries only a head+tail preview.

stdout.description: Captured standard output (empty when capture failed — see captureError).

stdoutPath.description: Sandbox path holding the FULL stdout, present only when truncated — page through it with tenki_exec (e.g. sed -n / tail -c).

stdoutTruncated.description: Present (true) when stdout exceeded the output cap and carries only a head+tail preview.
